item.summary: fix(gateway): stop persisting passive chat greetings into the durable logbook (#129506) Every fresh system-agent chat session persisted its generated welcome into the durable logbook, and the next session seeded that tail back as history. On a zero-history profile the embedded Control UI custodian (which loads openclaw.chat.history separately) rendered the identical 'Inference is ready' greeting twice — live plus under an EARLIER divider — and greetings accumulated on every reconnect. Persist a newly generated welcome only when the request carries genuine user input, or when a caretaker welcome delivers a one-shot external-edit alert (facts.recentExternalEdit) whose audit cursor advances on delivery and therefore must stay recoverable. Ordinary caretaker, onboarding, and new-agent welcome-only connections keep the greeting in live engine context without creating durable transcript rows. Reset boundaries and real conversation persistence are unchanged. Regression tests fail pre-fix for all three greeting variants: two consecutive welcome-only connects must not replay the prior greeting.
